messages:
marta: EU quiet rollout blocked by SBOM license check — deploybot flagged transitive dep 'libx' as 'UNKNOWN'. Can we fast-track? Need release notes decision and whether to pin or rollback. cc @sam-platform @liam-security

deploy-bot: [automated] Gate: sbom-license | artifact: service-eu:v2.3.0 | status: blocked | reason: transitive:pkg:pypi/libx@1.2.3(license=UNKNOWN)

sam-platform: ping liam - any quick check possible? If it's a tooling false positive we can annotate and proceed.

liam-security: looking. can you paste the sbom output? suspect purl/metadata mismatch.

marta: paste sbom snippet:
```
- pkg:pypi/libx@1.2.3?license=UNKNOWN
- pkg:pypi/libx@1.2.3?download_url=https://artifacts.example.com/libx-1.2.3.tar.gz
```
we pulled via our mirror, checksum matches.

liam-security: hmm license field empty in upstream metadata. tagging @jess-legal for license risk.

jess-legal: quick take — UNKNOWN license is risky for enterprise customers. If it's only in test tooling we can either remove it from final artifact or document it carefully and limit the rollout. Need confirmation of usage path.

nina-eng: libx is brought in by test-utils, not runtime code. our wheel builder currently includes test artifacts because of an overly-broad MANIFEST. We can exclude test deps from wheel and rebuild quickly (~1h).

oliver-release: options laid out: A) pin to vetted fork (hotpatch) + re-run sbom (2-3h) B) strip test deps and re-build (1h) C) timebox legal review + proceed with a 0%->5% canary for 24h (requires legal sign-off) D) rollback if unresolved in 4h.

marta: prefer B for speed and minimal customer impact. we'll exclude tests and cut new artifact. start now.

sam-platform: I'll kick a CD job when artifact is pushed: `./scripts/build-release --exclude-test-deps --region eu`

deploy-bot: Job queued: build/3123 by sam-platform. ETA ~12m.

liam-security: if the rebuild clears the sbom gate, please add a release-note line: 'Removed test-only transitive dependency causing license ambiguity'. Security will approve post-rebuild.

jess-legal: agreed — if rebuild >1h and we need to keep momentum, we can allow a limited canary with explicit release-note language and legal ok; otherwise prefer hold until sbom clears.

marta: noted. we'll stay on hold until build finishes. fallback: if not fixed in 60m, proceed with limited canary + explicit note + legal/marketing ack; if still unresolved in 4h, rollback.

nina-eng: starting patch to MANIFEST now, pushing new wheel to artifacts.

deploy-bot: build/3123 started.

sam-platform: monitoring logs — if sbom still flags libx we'll open hotfix PR to pin to our vetted 1.2.2-fork.

oliver-release: also updating release notes draft now:
`Release notes (draft): EU quiet rollout - bugfixes and stability improvements. SBOM: removed test-only transitive dependency (libx) that had an unknown license in upstream metadata.`

marta: thanks team — will report back when deploy-bot finishes the sbom check. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
